Using ideas from time sharing argument, double binning technique, Wyner-Ziv coding and Gelfand-Pinsker coding, a coding scheme is presented and its rate-equivocation-distortion inner bound is derived.

articleTitle: 2D to 3D video evaluation
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: A novel and simple method is proposed to predict the video results of 2D to 3D in this paper. Firstly, the motion features of 2D video frames for converting to 3D are extracted. Then, the motion feature difference between the adjacent two frames is computed and a threshold operation for denoising is adopted. Thirdly, some frames which meet certain conditions were chosen to compute the mean motion difference. Finally, the prediction score of 2D to 3D video results is obtained based on the computed mean motion difference. The experimental results indicate that the proposed approach can perform well for predicting the video results of 2D to 3D, especially for cartoon.

articleTitle: Checking delay-robustness of distributed supervisors of discrete-event systems
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper identifies a property of delay-robustness in distributed supervisory control by supervisor localization of discrete-event systems (DES) with communication delays. In previous work a distributed supervisory control problem has been investigated on the assumption that inter-agent communications take place with negligible delay. From an applications viewpoint it is desirable to relax this constraint and identify communicating distributed controllers which are delay-robust, namely logically equivalent to their delay-free counterparts. For this we introduce interagent channels modelled as 2-state automata, compute the overall system behaviour, and then present an effective computational test for delay-robustness. From the test it typically results that the given delay-free distributed control is delay-robust with respect to certain communicated events, but not for all, thus distinguishing events which are not delay-critical from those that are. The approach is illustrated by a work-cell model with three communicating agents.

articleTitle: Fault location for optical transmission line by signal multiplexing method
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Two signal multiplexing schemes have been proposed and experimentally demonstrated in optical time domain reflectometry (OTDR) for fault location of fibre optical transmission line to obtain high measurement efficiency. The backscattered Rayleigh light of the multiplexing probe signals is transferred to corresponding heterodyne intermediate frequency (IF) through heterodyning with single frequency local oscillator (LO). Then the detected signals are demultiplexed and finally extracted by digital signal processing method. Experimental results show that by use of the multiplexing method, the measurement efficiency of OTDR can be enhanced by nearly 16 times.

articleTitle: Time-domain method for DOA estimation of LFM signals based on block-sparsity recovery
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Under the current array system, a new method for wideband LFM signal Direction-of-Arrival (DOA) estimation is proposed, without restriction to the Shannon-Nyquist sampling theorem as like as the frequency-domain techniques. The key point of this method is to use the blocksparsity of several time source signals to build a blocksparse model for the array receiving several snapshots, then the DOA estimation problem of LFM signals can be reformatted as a block-sparsity recovery problem which can be solved by various algorithms. The experimental results demonstrate the superior estimation performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Load forecasting based on weighted kernel partial least squares algorithm in smart grid
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of electricity consumption forecasting in smart grid, a novel penalized weighted kernel partial least squares algorithm is presented. The original inputs are mapped into a high dimensional feature space to realize the linearization of nonlinear problems. The partial least squares algorithm is used to extract the principal component to reduce the dimensional of data. According to the local learning theory, a weighted least squares regression model is constructed based on the new data set formed by the principal component. The model sensitivity of abnormal data is reduced and the model parameters are optimized.The data from industrial electricity consumption of Jiangsu province in 2008 are used for validation and the results show that WK-PLS has higher accuracy than PLS in electricity load prediction.

articleTitle: The design of the pointing errors testing device for anti-aircraft artillery
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In this paper, the research purpose is how to measure the errors of the gun barrel pointing to the target for the towed anti-aircraft guns. The paper proposes an image processing algorithm based on the local entropy to solve the problem of the pointing error. First, fix the CCD image acquisition device on the gun barrel and ensure that its optical axis be parallel to the barrel axis. Second, the target video images are captured during the target tracking process and are processed with the algorithm based on the local entropy, and so the errors of the CCD optical axis pointing to the target can be obtained. At last, by the parallax correction, the errors of the gun barrel pointing to the target can be gotten. After the field test, the algorithm's effectiveness and practicality for this device have been validated.

articleTitle: Research and design of system on monitoring and analyzing the internet information for food safety
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: For the actual demand on food safety emergency management, this paper researches some key techniques such as web page crawling that collects subject-related and timely information, the deceptive spam opinion identification which based on the machine learning method of “learning from positive and unlabeled examples”, the food safety incidents' information extraction and warning which based on the ontology and so on. On the basis above, this paper researches and designs the system on monitoring and analyzing the Internet information for food safety, and the system prototype has been achieved.

articleTitle: Design and application of a digital frequency discriminator constructured by two counters
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: For solving the problems that exist in the design of digital frequency discriminator (DFD) of an all-digital phase-locked loop (ADPLL), a digital frequency discriminator constructured by two counters is proposed. It is designed firstly by using electronic design automation (EDA) technology, and then is applied to the design of ADPLLs. The register transfer level (RTL) circuit schematic and simulation diagram of the frequency discriminator are both given, and the system simulation of an ADPLL is then implemented in the paper. Experimental results show that the proposed DFD is adapted accurately and sensitively to the frequency variation of both the input and feedback signals, and gives corresponding clear frequency polarity signal. For those ADPLLs with this proposed DFD, the design complexity will be obviously reduced, the capturing speed of the loop frequency be significantly increased, and system performance be clearly enhanced. It can also be applied to the design of system on chip (SOC) phase-locked loop.

articleTitle: Research and practice control system of stereo-storage based on the PLC
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: With the fast development of globalization economy, workload of industrial automation increases exponentially which will lead to an increasing control demand, practically, effectively and reliably. In this paper, stereo-storage, an effective way to save space and time, has been chosen as an object to study. The stereo-storage mainly consists of a mechanical system and a control system. The mechanical system includes five layer shelves and motor drive (vertical lifting and horizontal feed) systems. The control system, referring to an operation part and a control part, has been paid close attention to this work. The display is a kind of the operation part which is a human-computer interaction platform; while the control part is made up of the PLC and the frequency converter. Testing the control system of stereo-storage demonstrates an enhanced performance and the control system have been proved to facilitate control and protection of the mechanical system.

articleTitle: Implementation of controller optimization using S-function based metaheuristic algorithms
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper presents general technique for implementing metaheuristic algorithms using S-Functions and its application in controller parameter optimization. The proposed method provides a suitable platform for parameter tuning in MATLAB/Simulink and PLECS software platforms. The proposed technique is suitable for exchanging optimization parameters when the objective function is not expressed in closed mathematical form. The S-Function based technique takes advantage of the software framework by embedding function calls of the optimization algorithm in callback methods which are executed at predefined time intervals. This leads to great improvement in algorithm efficiency in terms of simulation speed and ease of implementation. Validity of the proposed method is verified by implementing the particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) as an S-Function. The S-Function based PSO algorithm is applied to tune PI controllers for converter control in a doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) wind generation system.

articleTitle: An approximation algorithm for connected dominating set in wireless ad hoc network
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The dominating set problem in graphs asks for a minimum size subset of nodes with the following property: each node is required to either to be in the dominating set, or adjacent to some nodes in the domination set. The connected dominating set is a dominating set which is connected. The connected dominating set in unit-disk graph has been proposed as virtual backbone or spine for wireless ad hoc network. This paper propose a simple and effective distributed algorithm namely INMCDS algorithm for wireless ad hoc network, By this algorithm, the rout searching of wireless network is centralized in connect dominating set. The simulation experiment show that the algorithm we proposed could construct a proximately optimal minimum connect dominating set speedily. For the network topology changed as several node is disabled, the localized maintaining algorithm could construct a new MCDS speedily by the information of neighbouring nodes, so as to resolve the problem very well.

articleTitle: The combination message scheduling of FlexRay 3.0.1 statica segment
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The FlexRay bus is a promising automotive standard communication system with high-speed, high-bandwidth and high robustness. In this paper, based on Flexray Version 3.0.1, it is allowed to put the signals from different nodes to a slot. Because the static segment of FlexRay is based on Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) in the static segment, the real-timing scheduling of static segment is critical for an efficient system. To save more slots for the potential addition of tasks and improve the network utilization is significant to the further development of the vehicle area. Therefore, combination bin-packing algorithm is employed to merge those messages in the slots which are not fully used, despite that those messages come from different nodes, which is to improve the bandwidth utilization and minimize the number of used-slots and balance the every slot occupied rate. Finally, with the repeat rate unlimited to 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>, through comparing the experimental results of before and after combination of simulated static scheduling and the results do decrease the number of used slot and balance occupied rate. The solution of combining the tasks before sending to the network and segmenting them after receiving from the network will be a feasible method to the constrained network.

articleTitle: A metadata management framework for marine information based on XML
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a XML system framework of the marine metadata for application optimization of marine metadata database and its standardizing definitions. And gives a detailed XML schema description in detail for the framework. Finally a 3-layer process structure model based on the XML metadata management system is put forward to improve the efficiency of storing and managing the marine metadata.

articleTitle: A new algorithm: Extracting text information from Webpage based on block and tag-function
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: A Webpage contains lots of information that users needed, however it also fills with plenty of noises. How to remove these noises and extract useful text information has become one of the hottest topics in the field of Web data mining. This paper proposes a text information extraction algorithm based on visual information and tag-function. In this algorithm, firstly a webpage is divided into different blocks, and then we extract text information from these blocks based on rules, which are extracted from the characteristics of tag-function. Experiments show that the algorithm is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Modelling and delay-independent stability analysis of multi-sampling rate MIMO networked control system with state feedback
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: A kind of Multi-Input & Multi-Output control system with state feedback in which the controller of each control loop is connected with the sensor and actuator by a network and the sampling period of each control loop is different, is analyzed in this paper. The structure and mathematical model of this multi-sampling rate MIMO networked control system with state feedback is given. After it is transformed into a single high-dimensional linear time-invariant system by lifting technological method, its delay-independent stability condition is deduced based on Yaupon stability criterion and the linear matrix inequality method and time-delay system theory. Finally, a given numerical example demonstrates the correctness and feasibility of the derived method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on battery initial charging current strategy based on fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Decay coefficient of current plays an important role for battery rapid charging. This paper studied the decay coefficient of current of single Lead-acid battery using the partition charge pattern, the effects of recycling number, specific gravity of electrolyte, initial charging current on the decay coefficient of current. The results showed that decay coefficient of current keep constant between t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> and t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">mid</sub>. The maximum decay coefficient of current can be achieved when the relationship of initial current and electrolyte specific gravity arrived at an optimal value.

articleTitle: Generating spectral amplitude code labels by employing a single laser and a Fabry-Perot tunable filter for optical label switching
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: A novel method of generating multi-frequency spectral amplitude code (SAC) labels with a single laser and a Fabry-Perot tunable filter is proposed. A substantial simplification in terms of required optical sources to build a SAC label transmitter is offered by this proposal. SAC label up to 16 frequencies is generated by a single wavelength laser, and the label bit rate is enhanced to 1.25 Gb/s. SAC labeled switching system performance analysis with 40 Gb/s intensity modulation (IM) payload is estimated by computer simulation. Received label and payload qualities are assessed by bit error rate (BER) as a function of received optical power and optical signal-to-noise (OSNR), respectively.

articleTitle: A novel method for crowd density estimations
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Crowd density estimation is important in crowd analysis; this paper proposes a new approach used for crowd density estimation. First, background is removed by using a combination of optical flow and background subtracts methods. Then according to texture analysis, a set of new feature is extracted from foreground image. Finally, a self-organizing map neural network is used for classifying different crowds. Some experimental results show compared to former crowd estimation methods, the proposed approach can carry out estimation more accurately; the rate of true classification is 85.6% on a data set of 500 images.

articleTitle: Decision-making on maintenance for systems with hidden failures
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: A model of maintenance for a system with hidden failures was developed, which is intended to improve the existing methods of maintenance decision making. In the system, failures may not be observed by the operators of the systems and if the existing hidden failures can not be detected, secondary failure will induced in case some typical failures happen to it. In order to detect the hidden failures, detective maintenance is conducted periodically. For a decision-making on the maintenance work, expected length of a life cycle of the system and costs related to the failures and maintenance are modeled on a basis of analyzing possible events in the life cycle. The optimal interval of detection then can be obtained by minimizing life cycle cost per unit time using the proposed model.

articleTitle: Application of a grey combined prediction model with weighted compensation
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The real-time response and the rapidity are the special requirements for an online prediction system. The original data sequence of this system may have some features, such as a few sample data, non-index, and strong randomness, which bring some difficulties to the online prediction. In this paper, a solution is proposed to improve the shortcomings and deficiencies of a traditional grey prediction model. This solution is built based on the optimized Verhulst model. It is also combined with some other methods, such as the normalization, residual error correction, dynamic weighted compensation, to enhance the reliability and the prediction accuracy in a medium-long term forecasting. Finally, this model was applied to a simulated short-circuit situation in a low voltage distribution system to achieve the real-time online prediction. The comparative tests of several different kinds of models are given. And the results show the practicality and effectiveness of this proposed model.

articleTitle: Energy demodulation scheme for mixing GMSK signal in time-frequency domain
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: A new demodulation scheme was presented for two component of mixing GMSK signal in time-frequency domain. The proposed algorithm is based on the difference equation of the mixing signal and nonlinear energy operators. The first derivative of the mixtures is achieved according to the principle of the GMSK signal, and the amplitude of every component takes on the character of slow variation and contains modulated codes, which can be estimated employing energy operator and differential energy operator. Simulation results demonstrated the efficiency of the scheme.

articleTitle: An adaptive calibration applying SLRA for gaze tracking
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Video-oculography (VOG) is one of the most attractive gaze tracking techniques because of its convenience and simplicity, the purpose of the calibration of VOG gaze tracking system is to find the mapping function between the point of gaze (POG) in the equipment coordinates and the eye movement features in the image coordinates. In this paper, an adaptive calibration applying Stepwise Linear Regression Analysis (SLRA) for VOG gaze tracking systems will be introduced. We use a high order polynomial expression as a primary mapping function, then estimate the significance of the variables of the mapping function, and get the best mapping function by removing non-significant variables. The experimental result shows that the average error of this method is less than 0.5°. The proposed method has better accuracy and stability compared with the traditional quadratic polynomial mapping method.

articleTitle: Unfair rate limiting on traffic aggregates for DDoS attacks mitigation
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks pose a threat to network applications. Many countermeasures have been proposed to tackle such attacks. This paper focuses on DDoS mitigation techniques, the practical way to filter attack traffic and keep victims alive. To rate limit attack traffic with as little normal traffic affected as possible, not just the amount of increased volume, but also how increased traffic is propagated in the network, denoted by traffic increasing patterns, is considered. In this paper, we propose unfair rate limiting (URL), in which traffic aggregates are given different priority by extracting increasing patterns and analyzing their relationship with DDoS attacks. Aggregates more likely to include attacks traffic are punished harder during mitigation. Basic and fine-grained unfair rate limiting mechanisms (BURL and FURL) are presented upon port-flows and bitwise-flows, respectively. Simulation results show that both two mechanisms can effectively mitigate DDoS attacks. But FURL outperforms BURL in filtering attack traffic without dropping normal packets.

articleTitle: Grid independence and scheme research for simulating aerodynamic drag of MIRA model
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Grid scheme is discussed, which has a great influence on the result of numerical simulation of vehicle aerodynamic drag. Based on current adequate computing resource, the notchback MIRA model was built, and tetrahedral mesh and polyhedral mesh were separately generated. Then grid refinement was respectively performed around the model and at the rear of the model and sufficient grid number was guaranteed. Numerical grid-independent results were obtained, and variation tendency of drag coefficient with the grid number growth was summarized. In addition, the numerical simulation results were compared with those of wind tunnel test. The results show that once grid refinement is implemented, drag coefficient is significantly decreased. The decline curve of drag coefficient gradually levels off with the increasing grid number and grid-independent results can be gained when the grid number increases. The final drag coefficient is less than the experimental data of wind tunnel test and there is an error between them.

articleTitle: A scene image recognition method based on extension features
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: To improve the performance of scene image recognition, new recognition methods based on extension features are presented. Using expansion and contraction transform, a new extension color histogram feature E-hist and related recognition method are designed. Then, another new extension feature E-SURF is designed based on divergence analysis. The corresponding recognition method is also proposed with displacement transformation of extension theory. Large quantities of experiments show that the two extension features work well and the presented recognition method can improve scene image recognition accuracy effectively.

articleTitle: Cooperative bare bone particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Although bare bone particle swarm optimization (BPSO) is a promising algorithm without employing accelerating coefficients compared with traditional particle swarm optimization (PSO), it also inevitably tends to converges prematurely, especially for problems with multiple extremes. In this paper a cooperative learning strategy is applied to enhance the performance of BPSO. The proposed method uses a group of particles participating in exploring optimal solution. Depending on how the particles contribute to search step size, three different versions have been proposed and tested. The performances, both in solution quality and convergent rate, of these algorithms will be reported here. Tested on a suite of unimodal and multimodal benchmark functions justified the feasibility of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Monotonicity of asynchronous gradient method for RPNN
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The Ridge Polynomial neural network is one of the most popular higher-order neural networks, which has the powerful capability of approximating reasonable functions. In order to select appropriate learning parameters to perform an efficient training, the monotonicity of asynchronous gradient method is proved for training Ridge Polynomial neural networks.

articleTitle: Robust estimate for exterior ballistic trajectory based on sparse parameters fusion modeling
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The fusion with multi-measure data, such as optical measure, radar measure, and GPS and BDS data to estimate the exterior ballistic trajectory is a tendency for the high precise measure system in the current shooting range. However, the outlier and the model difference are inevitable commonly in these measure data, which will greatly influence the estimate precision. In this paper, the fusion measure model is presented, and then a robust estimate method to eliminate the outlier influence on the exterior ballistic trajectory is analyzed. Besides, the corresponding estimate algorithm and calculation steps based on robust estimate theory are established. Finally, the simulation calculation shows that the proposed method can effectively decrease the influence of the outlier and the model difference to the estimate precision. Compared with the traditional sparse parameter estimate method, this method is really effective.

articleTitle: A dynamic spatial cloaking algorithm for location privacy
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: With the growing popularity of Global Positioning System (GPS) enabled mobile devices, a widespread using of Location-Based Service (LBS) has become reality. Due to untrusted service providers, reporting private location information may lead to several security threats. Traditional K-anonymity algorithm deals with location privacy protection problem by a cloaking region. Inspired by this idea, we propose Dynamic Cloaking Algorithm, which runs on anonymity server and turns user's location into a dynamic cloaking region before sending to LBS Database Server. The cloaking region is generated randomly according to user's velocity and this process is proved irreversible. Experimental results show the our algorithm obviously improves the success rate and scalability of cloaking region constructing. Our algorithm decreases the payload at LBS Database Server and has a better anonymity.

articleTitle: An evaluation method for college library website based on evolutionary neural network
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Library website is the window showing the service of modern college library. It is very important to evaluate the library website and improve its quality. In this study, the evaluation index system of library website is established firstly. Then, an intelligent method to evaluate college library website based on evolutionary neural network is proposed. An evaluation model of evolutionary neural network for college library website is founded. The illustrational results show that we can realize a fast and accurate evaluation for college library website by this method. It gives a beneficial academic reference to promote the construction quality of library website.

articleTitle: Research on fault detection of FPSO production process based on the kernel function
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: FPSO(Floating Production Shortage and Offloading) production process fault detection method based on a combination of kernel functions with multivariate statistical is introduced. Kernel function mapping the nonlinear problem is converted into a high-dimensional linear feature space analysis and mapping data in high-dimensional space to extract the nonlinear characteristics to identify the fault. The experimental results show that the kernel function combined with multivariate statistical methods for the FPSO production process fault detection are very effective.

articleTitle: An approach of Bayesian networks in magnitude forecast based on earthquake trace cloud
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Magnitude forecast is an indispensable part of the earthquake forecast. In order to get better predicting results, this paper expounds the theory of earthquake trace cloud, and introduces the Bayesian network method to improve it and develop the automated processing. Firstly, the paper selects the proper variables after analysing the features of earthquake trace cloud and the practical situation. Then the paper completes the Bayesian learning to build the Bayesian network model of magnitude forecast. Finally the paper uses the junction tree algorithm to do Bayesian inferences to predict magnitude. The experimental results indicate that Bayesian network is effective in magnitude forecast, and it has advantages over the manual network and Naive Bayesian network.

articleTitle: Building up a computer model to simulate the impact of carbon emission mitigation on economy society in China
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This article describes a computer model, SICGE-IESOM model, which is composed of SICGE, IESOM and linkage module. SICGE model is one of energy-economyenvironment integrated assessment model, based on GEMPACK software, used to analyze the impact of carbon tax policies on Chinese macro economy. IESOM, based on GAMS software, is used for describing energy system. In linkage module, bidirectional connections between SICGE and IESOM are set up through variables such as energy service demand, technical variables and investment cost. Three scenarios are simulated to analyze the effect of carbon emission mitigation. The results indicate mitigation will cause GDP loss, affect residential consumption; emission reduction will decrease carbon emission intensity, ease energy supply pressure, accelerate the development of non-fossil energies, improve industry structure, and downsize energy-intensive industries.

articleTitle: Low power multilevel current-mode interconnect system with RLC Model
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a novel multi-level current mode for RLC interconnection system, which can effectively reduce the delay on the interconnect line and consume low power over long interconnect line. Interconnect wire inductance can decrease interconnect power and affect interconnect system frequency, while the technology of inductive peaking, which counteracts the high frequency attenuation due to the capacitance, will still work well. Simulation results show that the power consumption of the RLC interconnect system is 172uW, which is improved 100 times more than voltage mode buffer insertion techniques and lower than other current mode interconnect systems. Moreover interconnect wire power is also reducing over 6.6% due to interconnect inductance effect in 1mm interconnect wire.

articleTitle: Pose detection of parallel manipulator based on visual tracking
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This study addresses the pose detection of parallel manipulator based on visual tracking. Firstly, an improved mean-shift is used to track the moving platform, and then four points with significant features are chosen. At last, two affine invariants are exploited to detect the pose of the motion platform. The experimental results show that the parallel manipulator is tracked better by the proposed method under the condition of illumination changing obviously, and the pose parameters are obtained simply by the two affine invariants.

articleTitle: Biorthogonal wavelet transformation application in intelligent attitude/heading test system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: To test attitude/heading system (AHS) of aircraft as quickly and reliably as possible, the intelligent attitude/heading test system was designed after key technologies were conquered. Innovative design in the system is shaft-angle conversion card which can measure weak magnetic heading accurately. Meanwhile, heading and attitude testing precision is improved from 10 in original testing equipment to 0.10 present. Maintenance efficiency is increased by more than 10 times. Biorthogonal wavelet transformation technique is used for de-noising of the TQZ-1B gyroscope drifting signal. After wavelet processing, the testing precision of TQZ-1B gyroscope is increased by 5 times.

articleTitle: The choice of edge stopping function for weather facsimile chart processing
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Noise will lead to serious blurred and distorted weather facsimile chart, which will be an obstacle for the ship driver to obtain accurate meteorological information and make right decisions. And it is not good for the safety of navigation. Therefore, this paper establishes anisotropic noise reduction model, uses three kinks of edge stopping functions to control image diffusion speed and then performs noise reduction processing for meteorological facsimile chart. According to SNR and MSE evaluation indexes, the noise reduction features and noise reduction effects under different iterations and different noises of the three edge stopping functions are analyzed. The noise of weather facsimile chart is obviously removed by noise reduction calculation in Matlab, which shows that the noise reduction models of the three edge stopping functions are a feasible method to improve the quality of weather facsimile chart.

articleTitle: Integrating ZigBee lighting control into existing building automation systems
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Intelligent building automation systems require a large number of sensors to increase spatial resolution in order to achieve fine-grained sensing and control. However, traditional building automation systems are wired networks that require a tremendous cabling cost. In addition, cables themselves are unwelcome in many living environments. ZigBee has become an emerging wireless networking technology in recent years, which meets easy installation and flexible deployment requirements. Also, ZigBee technology satisfies the market's need for a cost-effective, standardsbased wireless network that provides a low power consumption, reliability and security. Therefore, ZigBee technology is very suitable for the networking of a building automation system. The goal of this paper was to develop a robust ZigBee wireless sensor network for building lighting control and to integrate the network into an existing building automation system. A Modbus-ZigBee gateway was developed to integrate these two different protocol systems. We tested our system in our testbed to verify the correctness of the gateway function and the network communication performance. The test results showed that ZigBee technology is feasible for use in building automation systems.

articleTitle: Develop a low price wireless binaural hearing device using 2.4GHz GFSK method
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Binaural hearing aids consist of two hearing apparatus, one for each. An intermediate device with an audio device to send audio data to two hearing aids simultaneously using wireless technology has already been developed. However, these devices have inconveniences in terms of carrying, usage and price by intermediate device. In this paper, a new concept of binaural hearing aid is proposed, one pair of wireless hearing devices are separated to be master and slave. A 2.4 GHz RF GFSK transmission method is used in this system for creating the wireless binaural hearing effect. The evaluation boards show a good performance in wireless data communication.

articleTitle: Component recognition of 3D fluorescence spectra based on wavelet analysis and weighted least square regression
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Wavelet analysis is widely used in signal processing. It is applied to the component recognition of multi-component three-dimensional fluorescence spectra in this paper. After the scattering peaks removed by the delaunay triangulation interpolation, the fluorescence spectra are transformed with the coif2 wavelet and the discrimination method is established by weighted least square regression. It is demonstrated that wavelet analysis combined with weighted least square regression provides an effective method for component recognition of multi-component three-dimensional fluorescence spectra.

articleTitle: Structural analysis and design of round belt drive snake-like robot
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Twisting between adjacent modules drive is the main way to drive the snake-like robot. It is hard to build a mathematical model for the kind of snake-like robot and the control of it is very complex in the realistic environment. In purpose of developing a new kind of snake-like robot which is easy to model, a new way to drive snake-like robot which we call skin drive was invented. With this way, structure of snake-like robot can be very simple and easy to model. Besides control of snake-like robot can be simple. Eventually a snake-like robot was built and it is called round belt drive snake-like robot. Through some experiment and analysis, it is concluded that this new kind of snake-like robot is easy to model and easy to control and its structure is simple to build. In this paper, three important topics were analyzed and elaborated. They are round belt analysis and design, active pulley structure and guide pulley arrangement. Of course, some experiments were done to verify the round belt drive snake-like robot performance. Some experiment process and results were shown at the end in this paper.

articleTitle: Hydrothermal synthesis of cysteamine capped CdTe quantum dots and its photoluminescence response to Ag (I)
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In order to study quantum dots (QDs) fluorescence analysis method using for the detection of metal ions, three sizes of water-soluble cysteamine (CA) capped CdTe QDs have been synthesized by hydrothermal synthesis method and characterized by UV-visible spectrophotometer and fluorospectro photometer. The photoluminescence (PL) response of CA capped CdTe QDs with particle size 3.49 nm to Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> has been studied. The results indicate that Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> has a great effect on the PL of CA capped CdTe QDs. In the presence of lower concentration of Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, the CdTe QDs exhibite PL enhancement, which is the result of the absorbed Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> passivating the traps on the particle surface of CdTe QDs. However, the PL of CdTe QDs shows obvious quenching with the further increase of Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> concentration, which indicates that the excess Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> facilitates nonradiative recombination and happens electron transfer with CdTe QDs after saturating the surface trap. Based on the PL response of CA capped CdTe QDs to Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, we can use the CA capped CdTe QDs to selectively detect Ag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>.

articleTitle: An optimized motion estimation algorithm based on UMHexagonS
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: UMHexagonS is one of the fast motion estimation algorithm adopted by H.264/AVC. It saves about 90% computational work compared with the Full Search Algorithm, and still keeps a good rate-distortion quality. In this paper, the characteristics of UMHexagonS were firstly analyzed, and three aspects of improvements, which include zero-motion block pre-determination after starting point prediction; improvement on 5*5 spiral search; optimized multi-grid hexagon search, were also proposed. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can save motion estimation time effectively and improve the real-time performance of the H.264/AVC encoder without much PSNR degradation and bit-rate increasing.

articleTitle: Structure research and failure analysis on Smart Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: With the concept of Smart Grid (SG) proposing, safe operations and supply rates are heating-points of SG research. The emphasis construction of SG is the construction of Smart Distribution Grid (SDG). The core functions of SDG contain how to improve the supply reliability of Distribution Grid (DG), how to plan and design the structure of SG reasonably and how to locate, isolate and restore faults quickly and accurately. This paper analyses the structure of SDG, and proposes a fast positioning algorithm of small current grounding fault in SDG and proposes a good method of how to recover the non-fault lines rapidly.

articleTitle: Application of reachability analysis based on time-dependent Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs equations
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: An algorithm is presented for computing the reachable set of a dynamic system. The algorithm is based on a proof that the reachable set is the zero sublevel set of the viscosity solution of a particular time-dependent Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs partial differential equation (HJI PDE). We implement this approach to a more realistic aircraft dynamic model which the control input of this model can be given by pilot rather than general intermediate variables. According to desired trajectory states, we can compute the backward reachable set in certain time interval and use the simulate result to verify actual trajectory status.

articleTitle: Robust task schedule model of Time Sensitive Strike information system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Faults and performance decline often occur and have a serious effect on task's timeliness when military information system works in the stormy battlefield environment, in order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a robust task schedule model based on the Primary/Backup(P/B) faults tolerance mechanism. At first, due to the 6 parts in Time Sensitive Strike (TSS) Time Sequence, TSS task is divided into small sub-tasks sequence, which is more closely to tasks in information system. Then, rules of TSS sub-task Time Window(TW) setting is designed. By using fuzzy control theory, triggering probability formula of sub-task delay and task scheduling is refined. At last, effectiveness of the schedule model is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Real time control of satellite formation reconfiguration based on Gauss Pseudospectral Method
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a real-time controller is presented to control the reconfiguration of satellite formation. The control algorithm is based on Gauss Pseudospectral Method (GPM). Different from the way using GPM for trajectory planning, the proposed controller only utilizes the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) multipliers generated during GPM. By using costate mapping theory, the initial costate information is obtained, which, together with the Hamilton canonical model, could be conveniently used to compute the optimal control for the formation reconfiguration. To eliminate the errors caused by model linearization and external disturbance, costate information is re-initialized periodically during the control process. The rapid convergence of GPM ensures that the reinitialization will not cause time lag in the real-time control. Also, compared to the conventional formation control methods, the controller does not need a guidance law during the reconfiguration maneuver. The simulations demonstrated the validity of the controller. The reconfiguration of formation can be carried out effectively both in time optimal case and in fuel optimal case.

articleTitle: Research on the Maximum Power Point Tracking method of PV array based on improved hysteresis comparison
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The Maximum Power Point Tracking technology (MPPT) is a basic technology which can improve the efficiency of photovoltaic power generation system. Improving the tracking accuracy and speed and reducing the probability of mis-tracking is the basic research direction in MPPT. In view of the insufficiency in the tracking speed and accuracy of the traditional hysteresis comparison method, this paper proposes an improved hysteresis comparison algorithm, which improve the tracking speed and steady precision of MPPT, additionally ,which can avoid the mistracking problem with a faster dynamic tracking speed in the case of the environment variation . The results of experiment and Matlab/Simulink simulation proved that the improved method has a faster speed and more accuracy in tracking the maximum power point of PV array, and the improved method can stably work in a dynamic environment.

articleTitle: Terrain page scheduling in flight simulation based on branch-and-bound search
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: To address the issue of unpractical and inefficient terrain page searching in terrain scheduling of flight simulations, we studied the scheduling problem for further optimization. Firstly the page format organization using the holding-boundary idea was introduced, which well disposed of the rendering sub-problem in scheduling. Then based on the organized pages, we proposed the branch-and-bound search algorithm to quickly search necessary terrain pages in flight scenes without redundant data. The algorithm regarded searching pages as searching optimal results in a solution space tree or graph, and it could be applicative to both query and prefetching sub-problems in scheduling. Experiment results showed that, compared with previous methods, our search algorithm could significantly improve searching efficiency but consume less memory space. Hence our method could offer better terrain page scheduling and smoother large-scale terrain visualization in flight simulations.

articleTitle: Face detection based on skin mask, number of holes and SVM
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper introduces a new 3-step face detection algorithm using MATLAB software. This 3-step algorithm is based on skin mask, number of holes in each region and Support Vector Machine (SVM) for face detection in RGB images. Due to the use of just 10 levels images in the proposed algorithm, the SVM training step is accomplished so fast. In addition, it will be shown that this method is so accurate in comparison with the previous methods, because of using these 10 levels just around the optimum threshold value.

articleTitle: Decentralized adaptive tracking of nonlinear large-scale systems with time-varying delays
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: A decentralized tracking control framework is developed for a class of nonlinear large-scale systems with uncertain nonlinear isolated subsystems and nonlinear interconnections with time-varying delays. The framework is Lyapunov-Krasovskii-based and guarantees semiglobal ultimate boundedness of the resulting closed-loop system. By virtue of fuzzy logic systems (FLSs), neither structure restrictions on the uncertain isolated subsystems nor a priori knowledge of the uncertain time-delayed interconnections among subsystems is required to design the controller.

articleTitle: Power humidity temperature modelling and control of proton exchange membrane fuel cells
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Effective power humidity temperature management is necessary for the safe and efficient operation of proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFC). Therefore a PEMFC modeling method and an intelligent proportional integral differential (PID) control based on neural networks strategy are presented in the paper to keep the PEMFC within the ideal operation range. Firstly, a power humidity temperature mathematical model is developed based on the molar conservation principles, energy balance theory and empirical equations. Secondly, the electrical power, humidity and temperature control structure and the intelligent PID control based on neural networks technique are designed, and the neural networks identification (NNI) model is applied to acquire the plant Jacobian information. Thus the electrical power, humidity and temperature are controlled by regulating the stack current, anode inlet water flow rate and cooling air flux respectively. Finally, the physical model, NNI model and neural networks (NN) PID controllers are simulated and analyzed in Matlab/Simulink software, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of the above means.

articleTitle: A new approach to detect pedestrian vehicles and bicycles
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Multi-view approach has been proposed in traffic monitoring for its robustness. Though there is much research work in classification, it is not easy to do so. In this paper, we describe a new approach to detect the pedestrian, vehicle and bicycles in the traffic relying on the muti-view information. In this approach, we do not detect objects from any single view; information is gathered from all of the views into an integrated framework and detection results are transformed to one view. Without relying on calibrated views, we use only 2D constructs to do the work. To this end, we adopt homographic constraint to obtain the synthesized foreground above the ground from multiple views. For the classification between pedestrian, vehicle and bicycles, we use SVM classifier base on the shape and size information. Experiment shows that our algorithm can classify pedestrian, vehicles and bicycles more accurate and easier and it provides a new way to use the muti-view information.

articleTitle: Research of machine learning methods for student management performance evaluation
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: We constructed a student management evaluation framework oriented information system through Java Web technology, which performs in-depth analysis for recent evaluation framework and processing un-structured data and semi-structured data. Meanwhile, considering the complexity of information for student management and subjectivity of measurements, we propose an algorithm framework based on Artificial Neural Network (ANN) aiming at constructing an intelligent integrated model through data mining technology. Evaluation on a student management data set collected from a polytechnic school shows the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm framework.

articleTitle: ACQA_onto: An ontology approach for restrain domain question answering system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper presented a restrained domain ontology model for agriculture cultivation question answering system - ACQA_onto. The question answering system (QA) has become one effective approach for knowledge engineering research. Ontologies could make the restrain domain concepts of semantics being understood by computer, which have been one significant technique for question answering system. This paper provided introduction ontologies in general and subsequently, in particularly, shortly provided the definition of domain ontology for agriculture cultivation. In main part, this paper presented the restricted domain ontology models and concept level vector space model of information retrieval (IR). The ontological representations of documents for agriculture cultivation question answering system was presented, and descript the prototype of ACQA_onto, in which part focalized with the process of generating answers from question. The result of ACQA_onto was proposed and the future work of question answering system for agriculture cultivation was introduced briefly.

articleTitle: TV logo recognition based on luminance variance
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: As the rapid development of intelligent TV, TV logo recognition plays an important role in the applications of video analysis and video retrieval. This paper utilizes the luminance variance information to extract logo mask along a set of consecutive frames. An effect and efficient method, projection distribution histogram intersection (PDHI) is proposed to calculate the similarity of two logos. Experiments are conducted on a large database collected by ourselves, including 57 challenging standard definition (SD) and 10 high definition (HD) TV channels, the results are promising.

articleTitle: Soft sensor modeling based on GD-FNN for microbial fermentation process
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In order to solve the problems in real-time measurement of crucial biological parameters (such as biomass concentration, substrate concentration, product concentration, etc.) in the microbial fermentation process, a soft sensor modeling method based on Generalized Dynamic Fuzzy Neural Network (GD-FNN) is proposed. Taking the penicillin fermentation process as an example, initially, the auxiliary variables of the soft sensor model are determined by means of the uniform incidence degree method. Secondly, generation criteria of fuzzy rules that contain ε-completeness are ascertained by use of the elliptical basis function. Finally, the soft sensor model is established by GD-FNN. Simulation results show that soft sensor modeling based on GD-FNN is faster in operating speed, and has a higher forecast precision and better generalization ability than Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network.

articleTitle: Information knowledgebase and satellite remote sensing for monitoring nuclear explosion
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Nuclear explosion monitoring is very important today because of the serious consequences of nuclear proliferation and the need for understanding the capabilities and threats presented by a State that conducts nuclear-explosion tests. Seismology, the most effective approach for monitoring underground nuclear-explosion testing, trends to provide much more sensitive detection, identification, and location of explosions. This capability depends on the research progress of travel-time and amplitude correction, event characterization, and regional tectonic models based on the support of the information knowledgebase. Satellite remote sensing technique is gradually developing as a very important way to track the preparation activities in known nuclear test sites or to exactly locate the event in combination with seismic signals. The studies carried out demonstrate the appreciable usefulness of combined seismic and satellite image analyses for CTBT verification.

articleTitle: An approximate method for solving the absorption coefficients
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In the measurement of flow field temperature distribution, absorption coefficient which is related to wavelength, temperature is an important intermediate variable. In this paper an approximate method for solving the relationship between the temperature distribution and absorption coefficients is proposed and then is fulfilled with a system of single-wavelength temperature measurement. The relationship between absorption coefficients and the radius is solved by inverse Abel transform, and then the relationship between the temperature distribution and the radius is obtained by a heat exchange model. At last, the relationship between the temperature and the absorption coefficients is obtained by eliminating the radius.

articleTitle: An effective error concealment method based on abrupt scene change detection algorithm
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Compressed video bit-streams are extremely sensitive to packet loss over error-prone channels. Error concealment (EC) has been considered as one of error control techniques to improve the reconstructed picture quality against transmission errors. However, EC methods show poor image reconstruction performance due to unavailable scene change information of the video sequence, especially when an abrupt scene change occurs. In this paper, we propose an effective EC method based on scene change detection algorithm (SCDA), which provides information to decide whether spatial or temporal EC is better to be used for intra and inter frames respectively. The simulation results show that the proposed method highly improves the subjective quality of incorrectly decoded frames and obtains an average gain of 0.7dB compared with the H.264/AVC Joint Model reference software.

articleTitle: Mining periodic behaviors based on GPS data
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The fast development of positioning technology and mobile computing is changing the way people contact with the Web, and brings us amounts of GPS data representing the users' location histories. In this paper, we will use smartphones running on Android to collect GPS data and then the data will be sent to a HTTP server at regular intervals. Based on different users' GPS data, we aim to mine reference spot and understand the periodic pattern. Here, the notion of reference is proposed to get places that users stay for a time. Thus, these places are used to represent the behaviours of users. With the sequence of reference spot, we can mine frequent periodic patterns and then summarize over these patterns. Finally, the experiments indicate our system shows efficient and stable performance with large numbers of GPS data.

articleTitle: An efficient pattern module scheme for mapping method
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The effective combination of pattern module and mapping method is the key to the successful mesh generation. Based on the current research of the pattern module, a new set module is constructed to improve the meshing efficiency and to extend application range of pattern module method. Meshes for several geometries are presented to illustrate the validity of constructed pattern module.

articleTitle: Weak feature signal extraction for small leakage in pipelines based on wavelet
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: For solving the difficult problem to distinguish weak signal of small leakage in pipelines, a method was presented to extract feature weak leakage signal from signal with much noise based on wavelet entropy. Not only the Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) could be increased and the feature was clearer, but also it is not sensitive with the form of signals. The nonlinear adaptive filtering was realized to weak signals according to the different characteristics between the useful signal and noise. Additionally, using wavelet packet elaborate frequency division the signal frequency bandwidth could be decomposed more subtly. The feature vectors of pipeline leakage and normal operation states could be formed based on frequency segment power, which could be used as input samples of neural network to improve detection accuracy to pipeline leakage. The experiment results showed the small leakage would be distinguished and located effectively.

articleTitle: A watermarking method robust for copyright protection of images against Print-scan
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a state art of robust watermarking techniques was first presented, Print-scan resistant digital watermarking algorithm, used in the environment of print and scan, will be able to solve the issue of copyright protection in the printed works. The robustness of a perceptual watermarking scheme based on a PJND (Pyramidal Just Noticeable Difference) model. Desynchronization attack known to be one of the most serious threats for any watermarking system. To cope with this type of attacks, we have proposed an approach based on the SIFT (Scale Invariant Feature Transform) and our PJND model adapted for the DoG (Difference of Gaussians) representation. The idea is to use JND to determine the optimum strength for embedding the watermark to provide an invisible and robust watermarking scheme. The image is first decomposed into a multi-resolution representation using the pyramidal decomposition. Then, a perceptual model is proposed to compute the JND value for each pixel at each Laplacian level. This model takes into account three main characteristics of the Human Visual System (HVS), namely: contrast sensitivity, luminance adaptation and contrast masking. The performance of the proposed technique is evaluated in terms of transparency, using subjective and objective tests, and robustness to different attacks from global transformation (Rotation, Scaling, etc) to local transformation (StirMark), including Print-Scan and Print Screen.

articleTitle: Random fibre laser
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The random distributed feedback (RDFB) fibre laser that provides stable, spatially incoherent continuous-wave lasing has been proved. It generates the distributed feedback fibre cavity which is formed by the Rayleigh backscattering in the fibre, and its gain is achieved by Raman amplification when the pump light enters into fibre, and its efficiency and performance are comparable to regular lasers. It is a new important type of light source for applications in nonlinear optics, detection technology and telecommunications which have attracted a great deal of attention recently. We review the research development of the random distributed feedback fibre laser and the mechanisms of the laser generation. Then, we introduce our work that two RDFB fibre laser schemes have been proposed, one is a kind of the RDFB fibre laser by cascading semiconductor lasers as pump light and the other is the wavelength tunable RDFB fibre laser.

articleTitle: Poly-line approximation algorithm research of induced voltage from rectangular loop over layered earths
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper discusses the poly-line approximation method for solving TEM response and the induced voltage of the rectangular loop over uniform layered earths. Because the non-zero offset expression of TEM response of rectangular loop contains a double Bessel function, according to asymptotic characteristic of the staple volume, the integration interval can be divided into [0,λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>] and [λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>,∞], and different calculating methods are adopted in two integration intervals. The results of the solution and the whole solving course are given in the paper. The results demonstrate that the methods are efficient and valid, and the results are accurate and scientific.

articleTitle: FEM simulation and analysis on molding process of infrared aspheric lenses
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Glass molding press (GMP) is a kind of mass production method to manufacture infrared aspheric lenses made from chalcogenide. However, it's hard to determine the molding parameters during the GMP process because the lens forming is conducted under the high-temperature conditions. In this paper, the finite element method (FEM) is used to simulate the GMP process based on the general Maxwell viscoelastic model and thermo-rheologically simple property. During the simulation, 2-D axisymmetric FEM model is constructed according to the different pressing velocities and friction coefficients, which change from 0.01mm/s to 0.5mm/s and from 0.01 to 0.2, respectively. To improve the simulation accuracy, the heating and pressing steps are separate and the heated result is taken as the pre-state of pressing step. The final results show that the best molding conditions are 0.1~0.2mm/s in velocity and 0.1~0.15 in friction coefficient for the infrared aspheric lenses made from chalcogenide of Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">55</sub>.

articleTitle: A MIMO based radar technique for imaging moving target
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The translation created by the maneuvering target has effect on image quality according to ISAR imaging. The traditional solution is to use complex motion compensation technology to eliminate the motion component. The MIMO radar system proposed in recent years also can use ISAR imaging algorithm to distinguish targets with its multi-channel observation characteristics and the reasonable configuration of transceiver array. The transmitter emits a series of orthogonal linear frequency modulation signals. So phase compensation and data rearrangement need to be done to maintain phase history. This method effectively reduces the imaging time and makes a good two-dimension ISAR image. So it can reduce influence of the target translation component to image quality. The simulation experiment obtains multiple scatters of rotation target image, and the experiment results have verified the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Stable biped locomotion using central pattern generators based on Matsuoka Neural Oscillators
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In this paper we address a control framework using central pattern generators (CPG) for the stable rhythmic biped locomotion. The mutually inhibiting and coupled nonlinear Matsuoka Neural Oscillators are used to generate the required signals to realize the coordinated movement of a musculoskeletal model of biped robot with 6 degrees of freedom. The proposed design of the CPG is verified through simulation. We present a comparative study between the proposed model and Taga's CPG model to find more stable and effective walking for the biped robot.

articleTitle: Autonomous hexagonal deployment for optimal coverage in mobile sensor networks
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Self-deployment is one of the main research issues in mobile sensor networks. It determines quality of service of networks, such as coverage and connectivity. In this paper, a novel autonomous hexagonal deployment algorithm for optimal coverage is presented to achieve the ideal hexagonal deployment. According to this algorithm, a self-deployment approach by adjusting centroid is proposed so that the stacking problem in traditional virtual force approach can be avoided. Moreover, the virtual force algorithm is used to improving the sparse deployment. Simulation results show that self-deployment by the proposed algorithm can effectively reach the ideal hexagonal deployment for optimal coverage in the mobile sensor network with concentrated or sparse initial placement.

articleTitle: Obsolescence management and evaluation of SSCS in nuclear power plants
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: The obsolescence management and evaluation for SSCs in nuclear power plants are discussed in detail. As an example, the main transformer of nuclear power plant is chosen to elaborate on the evaluation process of the obsolescence for the SSCs in nuclear power plants, including the overall process, principles, objects selection, process and results of the obsolescence issues evaluation. Through the obsolescence evaluation, the obsolescence issues that may exist are determined, optimized and solved before the time when the nuclear power plant performance is affected, to ensure the normal operation of equipment and the safe, reliable and economic operation of nuclear power plants.

articleTitle: Block compressive sensing based watermarking scheme for image tampering detection
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we describe a watermarking scheme using block compressive sensing for tampered image detection. The image is divided into several sub blocks whose size can be tuned by the data quantity of watermarking and tamper localization accuracy. The sub blocks were observed by compressive sensing using a Fourier matrix. The observing results were assembled to form the watermarking which will be embedded to the whole image. We save the watermarking and seed for image tampering detection. Test results proved higher security and scalability of the proposed scheme over conventional domain watermarking scheme.

articleTitle: Extract autocad BOM into access with visual C#.Net
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper introduces the method of how to use VC#.Net to extract the BOM of AutoCAD engineering drawings and save it to Access database that based on the AutoCAD secondary development. And give the key source program of C#, the developed software package on the basis of this method already has gotten a good application in practice.

articleTitle: The design and application of meta information move engine
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: Giving the definitions of meta, this paper briefly introduces the property of the meta in meta information move, the relationship between meta and meta information, the implication of meta, conductive transformation, meta identification of text information and the basic theory about the real-time active correlation and push of meta information. Based on such basic theory above, this paper devises meta information move engine and describes the various functional components in detail. Through maintenance management of human-meta, matter-meta, affair-meta information and affair-meta monitoring, meta information move engine can be used to push the real-time and relevant information and instructions to the meta-terminal according to the drive requirements of affair-meta. At present, meta information move engine is mainly considered to be used in academic activities, department store business industry, tourism industry, logistics and express industry.

articleTitle: Runtime message compression to improve the coupling in Earth System Modeling
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: As is extensively used in today's Earth System Modeling community, the coupler is a critical component aimed to link two or more large-scale numerical simulations called models. One basic function of the coupler is the parallel data transfer, which is used to exchange coupled data between models. With the advent of next-generation models, higher horizontal resolutions and more new coupling requirements will cause a large amount of communication to the coupler. Using runtime compression can effectively enhance the communication performance by reducing the data volume for transfer. In this paper, we study how to improve coupling performance by using the compression methods. Through two sets of tests using real coupled data, we characterize the performance of data transfer using compression on the clusters interconnected by Gigabit Ethernet and Infiniband, respectively. The results show that using LZO and two specific compressions proposed by us can achieve at least 1.05 to 5.1 fold speedups on the cluster with Gigabit network. The results also show that when the communication contention exists, using compression can achieve 1.3 to 3.5 fold speedups for the coupling between some models in an optimal computing environment.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a BPSK acoustic modem for underwater communication
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of an acoustic modem including transducer, analog transceiver and digital system. The digital system is responsible for signal processing and control and is the key part of the modem. We design the digital system targeting on FPGA for its power and speed superiority, and choose BPSK as the modulation scheme. Matlab simulation results and hardware software coverification on Xilinx Virtex5 FPGA demonstrate that the proposed BPSK modem works correctly and the resource utilization of the digital system on FPGA is provided in the paper. In conclusion, a BPSK acoustic modem is developed and can be widely used in underwater sensor networks.

articleTitle: Application and method of quality management for small-size software project
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering 2012 (ICISCE 2012)
abstract: This paper studies the quality management method in small-size software project. In traditional method, test and evaluation are prerequisite methods to improve the project quality.
